_howto: Newest first. Add an entry at the top each time you push an update; the website reads this file. tag: new | improved | fixed.

items.text: Title screen with the Beer League Hockey key art and a working main menu. Modes that are not built yet say Coming Soon.
Skating prototype (choose Exhibition): one skater, one puck, a full vertical rink with a scrolling camera.
Eight-way skating with acceleration, momentum, braking, gliding and carving turns.
Puck pickup, wind-up shots, board rebounds and two nets to shoot at.
Live tuning panel (backquote key) for speed, friction, turning, shot power, board bounce and camera.
